Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.orm

Package hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools

package hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools
Jakarta Persistence tool implementations backed by Hibernate ORM 6.

This package provides bytecode enhancement, semantic query model (SQM) query parsing, and database schema validation components targeting the jakarta.persistence namespace (JPA 3.x):

  • HibernateEnhancer – transforms compiled entity class bytes using Hibernate ORM 6 bytecode enhancement.
  • HibernateNamedObjectParser – compiles and validates named JPQL queries into SQM trees offline.
  • HibernateSchemaValidator – validates the JPA entity metamodel against a live database schema.
